name: usage-credits
description: Your usage credits (the pool Fable draws on) in the status line under the prompt: dollars left of the monthly limit and percent used, refreshed from your account every few minutes, with a warning toast as it runs low.

pollMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often to ask the account for the credit balance; it is also refreshed after a turn, at most every five minutes. The endpoint rate-limits, and usage-quota polls it too, so keep this modest

warnAt.title: Warn at (percent used)
warnAt.description: A toast when usage crosses this percent, and again at 95

showBand.title: Also draw a row above the prompt
showBand.description: The status line under the prompt always shows the balance; this adds a row in the band above the prompt too
